days.title: Arrive & exhale
days.subtitle: Bari to Monopoli · first Adriatic swim
days.morning: Land in Bari around 11:00 and make the easy rail connection south.
days.afternoon: Check in, wander the old town and swim at Cala Porta Vecchia.
days.evening: Seafood by the harbor, followed by a sunset passeggiata.
days.note: Keep this day deliberately light. Porto Bianco is a calm alternative for a first swim.

days.title: Coves & old lanes
days.subtitle: A full, barefoot Monopoli day
days.morning: Coffee in the centro storico, then walk to Porto Bianco before the crowds.
days.afternoon: Long lunch and an unhurried swim at Porto Rosso or Cala Paradiso.
days.evening: Aperitivo near the harbor and dinner within the old walls.
days.note: Choose just two coves—there is no prize for collecting them all.

days.title: Trulli day
days.subtitle: Must-do day trip to Alberobello
days.morning: Early bus or train connection to Alberobello; explore Rione Monti before peak heat.
days.afternoon: Lunch, quieter Aia Piccola and a shaded café stop before returning.
days.evening: Final Monopoli swim and relaxed seafood dinner.
days.note: Check FSE schedules the evening before; connections may be less frequent on weekends.

days.title: Cross to the Ionian
days.subtitle: Transfer day · Monopoli to Gallipoli
days.morning: Breakfast, check out and travel via Bari or Lecce depending on the best connection.
days.afternoon: Settle into Gallipoli and swim at Spiaggia della Purità.
days.evening: Circle the island old town at golden hour, then dinner by the water.
days.note: This is the longest transfer. Pack water and something good to read.

days.title: Punta della Suina
days.subtitle: The priority Ionian beach day
days.morning: Leave early for Punta della Suina and claim a peaceful patch by the pines.
days.afternoon: Swim, snorkel and linger; stay through the soft late-afternoon light.
days.evening: Return for aperitivo and a simple pasta or fish dinner.
days.note: Ask locally about seasonal shuttle service; taxi is the fallback if bus timing is impractical.

days.title: Choose your coast
days.subtitle: Baia Verde, Punta Pizzo or a slow town day
days.morning: Pick a beach based on energy and wind: Baia Verde is easiest, Punta Pizzo is wilder.
days.afternoon: Beach lunch and one last Ionian swim.
days.evening: Browse old-town lanes and watch the sun sink into the sea.
days.note: Alternative: keep the whole day local at Spiaggia della Purità.

days.title: Eastward again
days.subtitle: Gallipoli to Otranto via Lecce
days.morning: Take the regional connection to Lecce, then continue to Otranto.
days.afternoon: Check in, explore the cathedral mosaics and swim by town.
days.evening: Walk the bastions and eat overlooking the harbor.
days.note: Treat Lecce as a connection today—the proper architecture wander comes later.

days.title: Baia dei Turchi
days.subtitle: Pine paths and impossibly clear water
days.morning: Start early for Baia dei Turchi and walk through the fragrant pine reserve.
days.afternoon: Picnic, swim and snorkel; Alimini is an easy alternative nearby.
days.evening: Return to Otranto for a slow final Adriatic evening.
days.note: Bring shade, water and reef-safe sunscreen; facilities vary along the free sections.

days.title: Baroque finale
days.subtitle: Otranto to Lecce · Ferragosto
days.morning: One final Otranto coffee, then travel to Lecce and leave bags at the hotel.
days.afternoon: Piazza del Duomo, Santa Croce, local craft shops and a long café pause.
days.evening: Aperitivo and a celebratory last dinner in the honey-colored centro storico.
days.note: Ferragosto is a national holiday: book dinner and verify opening hours well ahead.

days.title: A presto, Puglia
days.subtitle: Lecce to Brindisi Airport
days.morning: Breakfast in Lecce and pick up a final pasticciotto for the journey.
days.afternoon: Train to Brindisi, then airport shuttle or bus for the flight to Zurich.
days.evening: Home—with salt in your bag and a camera roll full of blue.
days.note: Allow a generous buffer until the Brindisi departure flight is booked.

transfers.tip: Airport rail to Bari Centrale, then Trenitalia south.
A change in Lecce is normally required.
Train to Brindisi, then STP airport link.
